column1: # W-V1 pinned fixture manifest (SPECS/COMPONENTS/e3-wire/SPECS.md §13.3).
# Exactly three tab-separated columns, no header row:
#   <filename.mapr>
# The container digest is SHA-256 over the fixture's exact bytes in this
# directory.  The expected denotation digest is SHA-256 over the byte-exact
# decoded *output*: the evaluated root term (E2/C05 `eval_stream_digest`), which
# is what O7.7 and §13.4 step 8 require.  It is not a payload-table
# concatenation proxy.
# Provenance of every digest (no value here was invented):
#   * container digests: `sha256sum` over the committed fixture bytes;
#   * denotation digests: independently reproduced three ways — (1) C08
#     `decode_v1` + E2 evaluation materialised to bytes and hashed with
#     coreutils `sha256sum`; (2) the same stream hashed by E2's own
#     `StreamDigest`; (3) the identical value found in the container's own TRLR
#     stream SHA-256 field, which `decode_v1` verifies end-to-end and would
#     reject as `Mismatch` if the bytes differed.  The gate re-derives the same
#     value on every run (see logs/E3-G-legacy.log).
# Both readers (E3-G's legacy half and the C08 gate) parse this format.
